name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) captures 'If you move the ball, you must also take the key' (b may come before or after); Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) with the hard Existence(target_picked_up) captures 'Then pick up the box in the other room', forcing the key before the box pickup; all clauses are hard, matching the absence of any preference cue. The redundant warning on R1 is not a defect since the clause is stated by the task's if-sentence, and blocker_moved correctly gets no Existence because it appears only as a condition.

texts: If the blocking ball is ever moved, the matching door key must also be taken at some point.
The target box is not picked up before the matching door key has been taken; taking the key comes first, then the box pickup.
Eventually pick up the mission's target box in the other room.
